title: The Silent Guardian
description: An arc about the unavailable parent — the one who was physically present but emotionally gone. The traveler seeks a guardian who protects from a distance but never speaks.

acts.title: The Watchtower
acts.description: A figure stands on a distant hill, always watching, never approaching. The traveler has been calling to them since childhood.

acts.title: The Climb
acts.description: The traveler climbs the hill. The guardian retreats — not from cruelty, but from their own frozen grief.

acts.title: The Wordless Embrace
acts.description: At the summit, the guardian cannot speak. The traveler learns that some love is expressed in presence, not language.
